q: How many textile units have CCTS targets, and in which sub-sectors?
title: CCTS textile targets by sub-sector
short: 173 textile units got targets in the January 2026 amendment, in four sub-sectors: spinning, processing, fibre and composite. Each has a 2023-24 baseline. Many have targets for both 2025-26 and 2026-27, while some are set only for 2026-27.
audience: Textile mill owners and their suppliers in Gujarat, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu and beyond

ul: Registration numbers TXTOE001 to TXTOE173, with a state code.
Sub-sectors: spinning, processing, fibre and composite.
Example: one Tamil Nadu spinning unit, baseline 0.4355, 2025-26 target 0.4352, 2026-27 target 0.4329.

sections.h: If your mill is not on it
p: It has no target. It can still cut costs and earn offset credits under an approved methodology, and its buyers may still ask for its energy data.
